SELECT (SELECT NVL(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'PAID' AND P.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND P.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) AS CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'PAID' AND P.PAID_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND P.PAID_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') ) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_REVENUE,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'PAID' AND P.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND P.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) AS CURRENT_MONTH_PAYMENT_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S WHERE S.PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND S.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (S.END_DATE IS NULL OR S.END_DATE > SYSDATE) ) AS ACTIVE_PREMIUM_COUNT,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT P WHERE P.STATUS = 'PAID' ) AS TOTAL_PAID_REVENUE FROM DUAL

WITH MONTHS AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -(LEVEL - 1)) AS MONTH_START FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 6 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(M.MONTH_START, 'YYYY.MM') AS MONTH_LABEL, COUNT(P.PAYMENT_NO) AS PAYMENT_COUNT, NVL(SUM(P.AMOUNT), 0) AS PREMIUM_REVENUE FROM MONTHS M LEFT JOIN PAYMENT P ON P.STATUS = 'PAID' AND P.PAID_AT >= M.MONTH_START AND P.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(M.MONTH_START, 1) GROUP BY M.MONTH_START ORDER BY M.MONTH_START ASC
